caption: The server sends three 10 Mbit copies one after another, 5 s each, so client-server finishes at 15 s. In peer-to-peer the three peers also upload: 30 Mbit moves at 2 + 3 × 1 = 5 Mbps, so it finishes at 6 s.

spec.title: 10 Mbit file, 3 peers
spec.aria: A timeline with a client-server lane showing three 5-second copy bars ending at 15 seconds, and a peer-to-peer lane showing one 6-second swarm bar.
